patches.reason: Delete automatic Flash imports/device probing; use the author's existing QK/softmax/AV branch in AMP and FP32.
Explicit trusted official/experiment legacy checkpoint loading for Torch >=2.6; no global loader replacement.
Explicit trusted private strip_optimizer checkpoint loading.
Delete import-time telemetry and global torch.load monkey-patch; compatibility belongs at native checkpoint loading points.
Delete unused legacy global loader wrapper/capture.
Delete training-time remote pip update check.
Delete remote integration registration from this isolated comparison backend.
Delete implicit font downloads; keep installed fonts and existing native PIL default-font fallback.
Native FP32/AMP equality probe uses verified local same-family weight; unavailable probes cannot silently report success.
NumPy >=2.4 removed trapz; retain the native trapezoidal AP integration and shared comparison metrics authority.
Relocate image caches into per-experiment content-addressed cache, preserving dataset files.
Relocate label-scan cache ownership to per-experiment content-addressed cache even when image cache=False.
Delete JPEG self-repair writes from both native image verification paths.
Return the already-serialized lightweight checkpoint metadata to the shared save owner; one CSV read, native EMA/optimizer serialization retained.
Epoch budget owns loop/resume eligibility, without automatic extension; augmentation closure owns worker refresh; shared trainer owns selected-checkpoint closure history.
Normalize text line endings/trailing whitespace for reproducible Git checkouts; no semantic changes.
Delete unreachable Flash-only execution branch; retain author non-Flash QK/stable softmax/AV unchanged.
Delete silent AMP downgrade paths: requested AMP fails explicitly on unsupported devices or failed native probe.
Remove unused USE_FLASH_ATTN after deleting Flash-only execution.
Delete batch NMS timeout break that could silently omit remaining images; native candidate filtering, torchvision NMS, IoU and max_det unchanged.
